readme.run: Correct head motion with the shared NiFreeze-style estimator
notes: GP is the default; --method trivial selects the b0-template estimator.
The default mask is pinned MindGrab CPU applied to the mean b0.
Use --mask FILE for a mask on the DWI grid. --seed defaults to 1234;
--workers defaults to 1. Inputs are NIfTI plus FSL gradient tables.
This implementation resamples once and writes float32 BIDS derivatives.
Scientific scope and deliberate differences are documented in the package README.
